nodes.label: Fingerprint-based duplicate detection
nodes.rationale: Audio fingerprints (band-energy chroma codes) robustly identify the same recording across formats, bitrates, and small trims. Used as first tier of duplicate detection.

nodes.label: Name-based probable duplicate detection
nodes.rationale: Artist + title with duration within ±3 s identifies probable duplicates. Release labels and featuring credits ignored; other (…) parts kept.

nodes.label: Best copy selection algorithm
nodes.rationale: Ranked by: genuine quality verdict, lossless vs lossy, main folder presence, then resolution. Only best copy shown in views and used in playlists.

nodes.label: Waveform visualization in Duplicates
nodes.rationale: Each copy shows waveform scaled to group's longest song. Click to play from that spot, drag to scrub. When one copy plays, another play starts at same moment for easy comparison.

hyperedges.label: Duplicates feature: from detection to best copy display
